final_query_clean: What protections do pregnant employees have against termination?
llm_output:
Pregnant employees have strong protection against termination under Norwegian law (Arbeidsmiljøloven § 15-9):

**Key Protections:**
• **Cannot be terminated due to pregnancy** - Employers cannot fire an employee because she is pregnant
• **Presumption of discrimination** - If termination occurs during pregnancy, it is assumed to be pregnancy-related unless the employer proves otherwise
• **Protection during leave** - Employees on pregnancy/parental leave (§§ 12-2, 12-3, 12-4, 12-5) for up to 1 year cannot be terminated with effect during the absence period
• **Leave extension** - If lawfully terminated before leave began, the termination date extends by the duration of the leave period
• **Medical documentation** - Employer can require medical certificate to document pregnancy

These protections ensure job security for pregnant employees and those taking parental leave.

final_query_clean: What are the requirements for explosion risk assessment?
llm_output:
According to **Forskrift om helse og sikkerhet i eksplosjonsfarlige atmosfærer** (Regulation on Health and Safety in Explosive Atmospheres), explosion risk assessment requirements include:

**Key Requirements:**

• **Assess probability and duration** of explosive atmosphere formation during normal operations
• **Identify ignition sources** with sufficient energy to ignite explosive atmospheres
• **Evaluate materials and processes**: raw materials, production processes, chemical reactions, leaks, and their interactions
• **Consider hybrid mixtures** (combinations of gases, vapors, mists, or dust)
• **Assess consequences**: explosion pressure, heat radiation, flying fragments, and impact on people and property
• **Sufficient competence required**: Person conducting assessment must have knowledge of the facility, work processes, substance properties, explosion physics, analysis methods, and explosion protection
• **Collaboration**: Must be done with workers or their representatives
• **Documentation**: Results must be compiled in an **Explosion Protection Document** (§9)
• **Updates**: Risk assessment must be updated when changes occur

The assessment follows a systematic phase-based approach and uses standards like **NS-EN 1127-1** for identifying electrical and non-electrical ignition sources.

• **Integrity and dignity** - The right to be treated with respect in all workplace matters
